identities.attempt: cp02.attempts.attempt_id and monotonic fence, private capability token
identities.rawResponse: cp02.raw SHA-256 exact-byte content address and retained-response-v1 reference; per-attempt provider/dataset/grid source metadata retained in execution and index
identities.evidence: cp03.evidence: original exact CURRENTS V3 capture text and existing reference, plus storage text hash; deduplicated by captureId with exact conflict rejection
identities.executionBinding: cp03.bindings: distinct immutable attempt execution ID/digest and binding digest, raw/evidence foreign keys, full original record hash and authoritative context snapshot
identities.acceptedObservation: cp03.observations: logical job primary key, unique accepted attempt, cell/window/manifest identity and immutable references, timestamps, source metadata

contract.acceptance: AFTER INSERT cp02.accepted builds the index in the SAME transaction. Existing cp02.worker locked claim/fence/activation checks and deferred fenced_commit check remain unchanged. Any rollback, cancellation or deferred authority failure rolls back the index. There is no independent observation accept/write function.
contract.storage: AFTER INSERT cp02.results atomically creates immutable evidence and attempt binding. Raw may precede staging. No archival lookup returns pre-accept staging. All artifact writes remain behind CP-02 live claim checks.
contract.reconciliation: Exact same-attempt retries reuse the original result. Reclaim uses a new attempt/execution/binding, may deduplicate identical raw bytes and exact evidence reference/capture text, and can never promote the stale attempt. New evidence content requires its own existing V3 identity. No evidence is reconstructed on readback.
contract.replay: cp03.lookup returns accepted chain only. observationStorage validates exact raw hash/reference; retained original capture text and V3 reference; original execution/binding through unchanged Phase 1/2 validators; original record hash, context/job and every derived index field. Returns ACCEPTED_HISTORICAL only; no current/freshness claim.
contract.migration: Owner-only additive migration, transactional historical replay. Legacy changed/revoked unaccepted staging lacking its original activation context stays CP-02 audit-only; never fabricate context. Accepted legacy rows must replay completely or migration fails atomically.
contract.receipt: Nullable receipt_reference constrained to NULL; no Receipt Writer integration.

leastPrivilege.unchangedWriteSurface: Only existing cp02.worker(text,text,uuid,text,bytea); internal trigger functions inaccessible directly
leastPrivilege.publicAccess: No schema/table/function access; existing owner global function default-deny preserved
leastPrivilege.credentials: Existing outside-Git credentials only; no new credential or secret

proven: original exact V3 capture/reference round trip
one accepted record per logical job
crash before acceptance invisible and recoverable
reclaim reuses exact evidence without reusing old binding
direct procedure provenance mismatch with recomputed digests denied
all accepted chain readbacks and all table bytes survive real database restart
full migration replay and deployed-function source identity
no captain/user/session input reaches acquisition authority

developmentReconciliation: Sandbox subprocess launch denial resolved by authorized elevated local test execution; no system configuration change
Strengthened database operational provenance checks before final combined qualification
Legacy revoked staging is explicitly audit-only on migration rather than inventing original activation context
preservedBoundaries: Server-controlled acquisition independent of interactive context
Existing capture and normalization contracts unchanged
No production Supabase/deployment/provider configuration or paid services
risksAndLimits: Local synthetic-provider qualification only, not production or scientific requalification
Provider metadata records the Phase 2 request/adapter basis; not provider authentication or new scientific authority
Migration owner remains the approval trust root; a database superuser can disable triggers and alter records, while replay fails closed on tested tampering
SQL enforces operational provenance and content/reference integrity; exact scientific V3 semantics remain the existing trusted JavaScript admission/readback validators
Old CP-02 unaccepted stages with changed activation have insufficient historic context for promotion and remain audit-only
No scheduler/recovery orchestration, current-intelligence reader, garbage collection, storage retention policy or Receipt Writer integration

disposition.constraints: Existing credential/install/system/production/paid/governance gates remain; no Receipt Writer or production authorization
